notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

here's a few changes that were made in order to keep the game well balanced and fun as well as minor bugfixes

Balance Changes
+ your lives are now restored to the maximum amount upon game over
+ the skull head boss on stage 2-1 now has a proper health bar!

Bugfixes
+ the bug where the cat could take major damage while blocking captain Terryars's barrel attack has been removed
+ Mudge's end battle dialog in the Portuguese language was fixed

Please report any new bugs on our discord channel, twitter, or through email to goldenshelvessoft@gmail.com
